جرمن ایئرلائن یو ایس سی نے پاکستان کے دو بڑے شہروں کے لیے اپنی پروازیں شروع کرنے کی منصوبہ بندی کر لی ہے، جسے ملکی ایوی ایشن انڈسٹری کے لیے ایک اہم پیش رفت قرار دیا جا रहा ہے۔ اس سلسلے میں پاکستان سول ایوی ایشن اتھارٹی نے جرمن کمپنی یو ایس سی جی ایم بی ایچ کی نامزدگی کو باضابطہ طور پر قبول کر لیا ہے، جس کے بعد دونوں ممالک کے درمیان فضائی آپریشنز کا ایک بنیادی ریگولیٹری مرحلہ مکمل ہو چکا ہے۔

نئی غیر ملکی ایئرلائن کی پاکستان آمد سے یہاں کی فضائی مارکیٹ میں مسابقت کے بڑھنے کا قوی امکان موجود ہے۔ اس اقدام سے پاکستان اور جرمنی کے مابین فضائی رابطوں میں بہتری آئے گی اور مسافروں کو بہتر سفری سہولیات میسر ہوں گی، جبکہ اس کے نتیجے میں ملک کے اندر سیاحت کے فروغ کے نئے راستے بھی کھلیں گے۔

اس ایئرلائن کے مکمل آپریشنز شروع ہونے سے مقامی سطح پر ایوی ایشن کے شعبے میں کاروباری سرگرمیوں میں اضافہ متوقع ہے۔ طیاروں کی لیزنگ، گراؤنڈ ہینڈلنگ کے امور اور مقامی افراد کی بھرتیوں کے ذریعے ملک میں نئے سرمایہ کاری کے مواقع پیدا ہوں گے جو کہ معیشت کے لیے سودمند ثابت ہوں گے۔

ابتدائی نامزدگی کی منظوری کے بعد اب ایئرلائن انتظامیہ کی جانب سے باقاعدہ پروازوں کے اجرا کے لیے دیگر ضروری آپریشنل منظوریوں کے حصول کا عمل مکمل کیا جائے گا۔ اس تمام پیش رفت کا مقصد پاکستان میں جرمن ایئرلائن کی براہ راست پروازوں کا آغاز کرنا اور دوطرفہ نقل و حرکت کو آسان بنانا ہے۔

stories.title: لاہور کے ریس کورس پارک میں خواتین کو ہراساں کرنے والے دو جعلی ڈاکٹر گرفتار
stories.summary:
لاہور کے مشہور ریس کورس پارک میں خواتین کو ہراساں کرنے کے الزام میں دو افراد کو پولیس نے حراست میں لے لیا ہے۔ ڈولفن پولیس کے ترجمان کے مطابق یہ ملزمان پارک میں خود کو میڈیکل اسٹوڈنٹس اور ڈاکٹر ظاہر کر کے وہاں موجود خواتین کو تنگ کر رہے تھے اور اپنی جعلی شناخت کا غلط استعمال کر رہے تھے۔

خواتین کی جانب سے بروقت شکایات موصول ہونے پر ڈولفن فرینڈلی یونٹ نے فوری طور پر حرکت میں آتے ہوئے کارروائی کی۔ اس کامیاب کارروائی کے نتیجے میں دونوں ملزمان کو موقع واردات سے ہی دبوچ لیا گیا اور فرار ہونے کا کوئی موقع نہیں دیا گیا۔

پولیس کی جانب سے تلاشی کے دوران گرفتار کیے گئے ملزمان کے قبضے سے اسٹیتھوسکوپ سمیت دیگر طبی آلات بھی برآمد کیے گئے ہیں جنہیں وہ اپنی جعل سازی کے لیے استعمال کرتے تھے۔ پولیس کے مطابق پکڑے جانے والے دونوں ملزمان کی شناخت مہتاب اور علی رضا کے ناموں سے ہوئی ہے۔

گرفتاری کے بعد دونوں ملزمان کو مزید قانونی کارروائی کی غرض سے تھانہ ریس کورس کے حوالے کر دیا گیا ہے۔ اس واقعے پر بات کرتے ہوئے سی سی پی او لاہور فیصل کامران نے واضح کیا ہے کہ خواتین کے تحفظ اور ان کے عزت و وقار پر ہرگز کوئی سمجھوتہ نہیں کیا جائے گا اور ایسے عناصر کے خلاف زیرو ٹالرنس کی پالیسی پر سختی سے عمل جاری رہے گا۔

stories.title: France and Germany Push for Year-End EU Budget Deal
stories.summary:
France and Germany are urging the European Union to secure an agreement on its upcoming 2028-2034 budget and financial support for Ukraine by the end of the year. Leaders engaged in discussions on Thursday in an effort to finalize the framework ahead of multiple elections across member states in 2027, though substantive progress remained limited amid sharp disagreements. 

The seven-year draft budget totals approximately €1.582 trillion, which includes €140 billion dedicated to repaying pandemic-era borrowing and roughly €740 billion aimed at supporting European farmers and poorer regions. Because the package requires unanimous approval from all 27 member states, leaders are racing against time. Countries such as France, Italy, Poland, Greece, Estonia, Finland, and Slovakia hold elections next year, raising political risks. In France, far-right leader Marine Le Pen leads polls and has vowed to halt aid to Ukraine and cut French contributions, prompting French President Emmanuel Macron to stress that negotiations must conclude before domestic campaigns intensify. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz echoed the urgency of the end-2026 deadline. 

A key friction point involves ongoing funding for Ukraine, which faces a Russian invasion that began in 2022. The budget draft proposes up to €100 billion for Kyiv, while separate plans aim to borrow €45 billion under the current budget to be lent to Ukraine and repaid through future Russian war reparations. An additional €25 billion is anticipated from non-EU allies including Britain, Norway, Japan, Switzerland, and Canada for 2027. 

Controversy has arisen over whether every EU member should contribute to the €45 billion loan. Slovakia, the Czech Republic, Hungary, and Bulgaria oppose the move, while Germany and other net-contributing nations insist on mandatory participation as a prerequisite for the wider budget deal. These divisions underscore broader tensions between net contributors seeking spending cuts and competitiveness, and net beneficiaries advocating for continued regional and agricultural subsidies to maintain public support.

stories.title: بلوچستان بار کونسل کا جے یو آئی رہنماؤں کی گرفتاری پر ہڑتال کا اعلان
stories.summary:
بلوچستان بار کونسل نے سیاسی رہنماؤں اور کارکنوں کی حالیہ گرفتاریوں پر سخت ردعمل ظاہر کرتے ہوئے صوبہ بھر میں عدالتی کارروائیوں کے بائیکاٹ کا اعلان کیا ہے۔ بار کونسل کی اس کال کے نتیجے میں وکلاء نے عدالتوں کا بائیکاٹ کیا اور وہ عدالتی امور میں پیش نہیں ہو رہے ہیں۔

بلوچستان بار کونسل کی جانب سے جاری کردہ بیان میں جمعیت علماء اسلام (جے یو آئی) کے رہنماؤں اور سیاسی کارکنوں کی گرفتاریوں اور ان کے خلاف کی جانے والی کارروائیوں کی شدید مذمت کی گئی ہے۔ بار نے مطالبہ کیا ہے کہ تمام گرفتار سیاسی رہنماؤں اور کارکنوں کو فوری طور پر رہا کیا جائے۔

کونسل کا کہنا ہے کہ ریاستی اداروں کو شہریوں کے بنیادی، آئینی اور قانونی حقوق کا مکمل تحفظ یقینی بنانا چاہیے۔ بار نے زور دیا کہ حکام سیاسی کارکنوں کے خلاف کارروائیاں بند کریں اور آئین و قانون کے دائرے میں رہتے ہوئے شہریوں کے حقوق کا احترام کریں۔

اس احتجاج اور بائیکاٹ نے صوبے کے عدالتی نظام کو عارضی طور پر معطل کر دیا ہے کیونکہ وکلاء کی عدم موجودگی کے باعث سائلین کو بھی مشکلات کا سامنا کرنا پڑ رہا ہے۔ بار کونسل نے خبردار کیا ہے کہ جب تک گرفتاریاں ختم نہیں کی جاتیں ان کا موقف غیر متزلزل رہے گا۔

stories.title: ترک صدر نے پاکستان اور سعودی عرب کے ساتھ دفاعی معاہدے کی توثیق کردی
stories.summary:
ترکیہ کے صدر رجب طیب اردوان نے پاکستان اور سعودی عرب کے ساتھ طے پانے والے مکہ مشترکہ دفاعی معاہدے کی باضابطہ منظوری دے دی ہے۔ اس منظوری کے ساتھ ہی ترکیہ کی جانب سے اس اہم سہ فریقی معاہدے کی توثیق کا آئینی عمل مکمل ہو گیا ہے۔

رائٹرز کے مطابق جمعے کے روز ترکیہ کے سرکاری گزٹ میں صدر رجب طیب اردوان کے دستخط سے اس منظوری کا باضابطہ اعلان شائع کیا گیا۔ اس سے قبل رواں ماہ کے دوران ترک پارلیمنٹ نے بھی اس دفاعی معاہدے کی توثیق کی تھی، جس کے بعد اب صدارتی منظوری سے اس پر عملدرآمد کی راہ ہموار ہو گئی ہے۔

پاکستان، سعودی عرب اور ترکیہ نے رواں سال کے آغاز میں اگست کے مہینے میں مکہ مکرمہ میں اس مشترکہ دفاعی معاہدے پر دستخط کیے تھے۔ یہ اسٹریٹجک معاہدہ ایسے حساس وقت میں طے پایا تھا جب خطے میں بالخصوص ایران کے خلاف امریکہ اور اسرائیل کی بڑھتی ہوئی فوجی سرگرمیوں کے باعث سلامتی کے خدشات اور کشیدگی میں نمایاں اضافہ ہو رہا تھا۔

رائٹرز کی رپورٹس کے مطابق اس توثیق کے فوراً بعد تینوں ممالک کے اعلیٰ حکام جمعے اور ہفتے کو اسلام آباد میں ایک اہم اجلاس بھی منعقد کرنے جا رہے ہیں۔ اس اجلاس میں مکہ دفاعی معاہدے کے تحت سیکیورٹی اور باہمی تعاون کے امور پر تفصیلی بات چیت متوقع ہے۔

stories.title: Sindh Chief Minister Announces Consultations on New Local Government Law
stories.summary:
Sindh Chief Minister Syed Murad Ali Shah announced a broad consultation process in Karachi on November 26 regarding a new local government framework. Speaking at a press conference at the CM House alongside provincial ministers and Karachi Mayor Murtaza Wahab, Shah formed a two-member ministerial committee consisting of Syed Nasir Hussain Shah and Ziaul Hassan Lanjar to engage with political parties, civil society, and other stakeholders, with a mandate to submit a report within three months.

The initiative comes amid public discussions concerning the establishment of new administrative units and provinces across Pakistan, including Sindh, a concept strongly opposed by the Pakistan Peoples Party. The chief minister stressed that the upcoming legislation will arrive through amendments to the current local government law, and confirmed that the next local government polls will occur on schedule despite challenging political and security conditions.

The proposed legal changes aim to grant greater financial and administrative autonomy to local bodies, with funding enhancements to be determined via the Provincial Finance Commission. Responding to queries regarding a potential referendum on new provinces, Shah noted that nobody had approached him regarding such a process and recalled that the Sindh Assembly previously rejected boundary divisions within the province by a two-thirds majority.

The ongoing political discourse matters because it touches directly on administrative decentralization and provincial integrity in Pakistan. Strengthening local governments and addressing grassroots governance remains a critical priority for local leaders, making the committee's upcoming stakeholder recommendations pivotal for regional policy.

stories.title: کراچی میں غیر قانونی عمارت گرنے سے اموات 6 ہو گئیں
stories.summary:
کراچی کی ایڈمنسٹریشن سوسائٹی میں ایک غیر قانونی طور پر تعمیر کی جانے والی رہائشی عمارت اچانک زمین بوس ہو گئی، جس کے نتیجے میں جاں بحق ہونے والے افراد کی تعداد بڑھ کر 6 ہو گئی ہے۔ اس افسوسناک حادثے میں کل 13 افراد تاحال لاپتا ہیں۔ حکام کے مطابق اس حادثے میں جان کی بازی ہارنے والے افراد میں 6 بچے، 2 خواتین اور 3 مرد شامل ہیں۔

ابتدائی تحقیقات اور اطلاعات کے مطابق یہ حادثہ بدھ کے روز پیش آیا جہاں 600 گز کے رہائشی پلاٹ پر چھ منزلہ عمارت بنا دی گئی تھی۔ اس عمارت کا منظور شدہ نقشہ صرف گراؤنڈ پلس ون کا تھا، لیکن اس پر قواعد کے خلاف پانچ اضافی منزلیں تعمیر کر لی گئی تھیں اور چھٹی منزل پر کام ابھی جاری تھا۔

واقعے کے بعد صوبائی حکومت اور انتظامیہ حرکت میں آ گئی ہے۔ وزیر اعلیٰ سندھ نے بتایا کہ شہر میں اس وقت 143 عمارتیں حکمِ امتناع پر زیرِ تعمیر ہیں اور ان تمام عمارتوں پر فوری طور پر کام رکوا دیا گیا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ انتظامیہ نے شہر بھر میں بغیر اجازت کے زیرِ تعمیر ایسی تمام 143 عمارتوں کو سیل کرنے کے احکامات بھی جاری کر دیے ہیں۔

حکومتی احکامات میں واضح کیا گیا ہے کہ عدالتوں کی طرف سے حکم امتناع حاصل ہونے کی صورت میں بھی تمام غیر قانونی تعمیرات کو فوری طور پر روکا جائے گا۔ اس واقعے نے شہر میں عمارتوں کی غیر قانونی تعمیرات اور حفاظتی قوانین کی خلاف ورزیوں پر ایک بار پھر سنگین سوالات کھڑے کر دیے ہیں، جن پر قابو پانے کے لیے انتظامیہ سخت اقدامات کر رہی ہے۔

stories.title: جعفرآباد میں گرین پاکستان انیشی ایٹو کے ذریعے بنجر زمینیں قابلِ کاشت بن گئیں
stories.summary:
گرین پاکستان انیشی ایٹو کی بدولت جعفرآباد میں زرعی شعبے میں نمایاں بہتری دیکھنے میں آ رہی ہے، جہاں بنجر اور غیر آباد زمینیں اب کاشت کے قابل بن چکی ہیں۔ آبپاشی کے بہتر نظام اور پانی کی وافر دستیابی کی وجہ سے مقامی کسانوں کو خاطر خواہ سہولتیں مل رہی ہیں، جس سے گندم اور چاول کی پیداوار میں اضافہ ہو رہا ہے۔

اس منصوبے کے تحت کسانوں کو جدید زرعی طریقے فراہم کیے جا رہے ہیں جبکہ معیاری بیج اور کھاد بھی سستے داموں مہیا کی جا رہی ہے، جس سے زمینداروں کو بڑا ریلیف ملا ہے۔ مقامی کسانوں کا کہنا ہے کہ اس اقدام سے پہلے جو زمینیں ویران پڑی تھیں، وہاں اب فصلیںلہلہا رہی ہیں اور مجموعی پیداوار بہتر ہوئی ہے۔

زمینداروں اور کسانوں نے زرعی زمینوں کی بحالی اور سہولتوں کی فراہمی پر گرین پاکستان انیشی ایٹو کا تہہ دل سے شکریہ ادا کیا ہے۔ یہ اقدامات علاقے میں زرعی انقلاب لانے اور ملکی غذائی خودمختاری کے استحکام میں اہم کردار ادا کر رہے ہیں۔

stories.title: Punjab Revenue Authority Cracks Down on Businesses Evading Electronic Invoices
stories.summary:
The Punjab Revenue Authority (PRA) has intensified its enforcement operations across multiple divisions in Pakistan, targeting commercial entities failing to install or correctly utilize the Electronic Invoice Monitoring System (e-IMS). Special monitoring teams are active across the Lahore, Gujranwala, Sargodha, Rawalpindi, and Multan divisions to ensure compliance with digital sales reporting mandates.

During these recent field inspections, enforcement officers issued show-cause notices to more than 65 business operators found violating e-IMS guidelines. A PRA spokesperson emphasized that the agency will pursue legal action against establishments engaging in sales record manipulation, issuing fake receipts, or attempting to bypass tax obligations. Operators have been formally instructed to issue computerized receipts and maintain transparent tax logs, with severe penalties awaiting non-compliant businesses.

The digital monitoring rollout seeks to curb widespread tax evasion and enhance accountability within provincial revenue collection. Additionally, the authority encourages consumer participation by utilizing QR codes printed on computerized receipts, which enable customers to independently verify charged taxes in real time.

This enforcement drive matters because systematic tax compliance is vital for strengthening public finances and improving economic transparency in the region. By enforcing digital tracking, the PRA aims to close loopholes that have historically undermined revenue mobilization.

stories.title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Establishes Committee to Implement Jamaat-e-Islami Relief Proposals
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif announced the creation of a specialized oversight committee in Islamabad on Thursday to review and implement economic relief proposals put forward by a Jamaat-e-Islami (JI) delegation led by party chief Hafiz Naeemur Rehman. Meeting at a time of severe public pressure over soaring petroleum prices and living costs, the prime minister assured the delegation that the administration would execute viable recommendations in good faith.

Reflecting on past relief efforts following the Iran-US conflict, the prime minister noted that the federal government deployed Rs128 billion for nationwide subsidies before expanding targeted relief to owners of motorcycles, rickshaws, and vehicles up to 800cc. According to government figures, these emergency measures directly aided roughly 20 million citizens and indirectly benefited nearly 100 million people.

Following discussions, JI chief Rehman told reporters that the administration agreed to expand fuel relief to vehicles up to 1,000cc and deliver agricultural assistance for farmers owning up to 12.5 acres, including tractor-related support. Furthermore, authorities agreed to reduce the petroleum levy impact from Rs80 to Rs63 ahead of the next budget, phase out official vehicles exceeding 1,600cc, and review existing agreements with independent power producers. Rehman noted that lower power tariffs and IPP revisions have already reduced electricity bills by 25 percent over the past two years.

This agreement matters because it represents a major policy dialogue between the ruling administration and opposition figures aimed at easing financial distress for millions of Pakistanis. The newly formed committee will monitor ongoing progress, while JI maintains its broader political pressure pending a major rally in Lahore.

stories.title: भारतीय مداحوں نے پاکستانی ڈرامے 'درِ نجات' کی خصوصی اسکریننگ کا اہتمام کیا
stories.summary:
پاکستانی ڈرامے ’درِ نجات‘ نے سرحد پار بھی ناظرین کے دل جیت لیے ہیں، جس کی مقبولیت کا اندازہ اس بات سے لگایا جا سکتا ہے کہ بھارتی شہر نئی دہلی میں مداحوں نے اس کی ایک خصوصی اسکریننگ کا انعقاد کیا۔ اس تقریب میں شرکاء نے ڈرامے کے مختلف کرداروں پر کھل کر تبادلہ خیال کیا۔

اس ڈرامے کی تحریر عمیرہ احمد کی ہے، ہدایت کاری ثاقب خان نے دی ہے جبکہ پروڈکشن تھریز انٹرٹینمنٹ کی ہے۔ اسکریننگ کے دوران سب سے زیادہ گفتگو ابو بکر کے کردار پر ہوئی جسے شائقین نے مردوں کے لیے ایک بہترین مثال قرار دیا، جبکہ زریاب، حمنہ اور زامل کے کرداروں پر بھی آراء دی گئیں۔ بعض شرکاء کا یہ بھی ماننا تھا کہ پاکستانی ڈراموں کا بیانیہ بھارتی ڈراموں کے مقابلے میں زیادہ مختصر اور اثر انگیز ہوتا ہے۔

تقریب کے دوران ایک دلچسپ موڑ اس وقت آیا جب ہدایت کار ثاقب خان نے ویڈیو کال کے ذریعے شرکت کی اور مداحوں کی جانب سے پوچھے گئے سوالات کے براہ راست جوابات دیے۔ اس تقریب نے دونوں ممالک کے ناظرین کے درمیان ثقافتی اشتراک اور ڈرامے کی مقبولیت کو مزید اجاگر کیا ہے۔

stories.title: Carlos Tevez Hopes Cristiano Ronaldo Will Join Lionel Messi
stories.summary:
Former Argentina striker Carlos Tevez announced that fellow countryman Lionel Messi will participate in his upcoming testimonial match next month, while expressing optimism that Portugal legend Cristiano Ronaldo will also join them on the pitch. The testimonial event is scheduled for December 20 at the Bombonera stadium in Buenos Aires, reflecting Tevez's career origins and return to Boca Juniors before his retirement.

The 42-year-old Tevez previously shared the pitch with Messi for the Argentina national team and played alongside Ronaldo during his time at Manchester United. If Ronaldo agrees to take part, the match could mark the historic first time that Messi and Ronaldo—who defined a generation of football through numerous El Clasico clashes between Barcelona and Real Madrid—play on the same side.

Additional football stars slated to appear in the testimonial include Italian goalkeeper Gianluigi Buffon, Argentine midfielder Juan Roman Riquelme, and former England central defender Rio Ferdinand. The event is expected to draw significant attention as a rare gathering of legendary football icons.

stories.title: بنگلہ دیش میں گارمنٹس ورکرز کے شدید احتجاج پر پولیس کی آنسو گیس شیلنگ
stories.summary:
بنگلہ دیش کے صنعتی مرکز غازی پور میں کم از کم اجرت میں اضافے کا مطالبہ کرنے والے گارمنٹس ورکرز کو منتشر کرنے کے لیے پولیس نے آنسو گیس کے شیل اور ساؤنڈ گرینیڈ استعمال کیے۔ جمعرات کے روز شروع ہونے والے اس تازہ احتجاج کے دوران مظاہرین نے ایک اہم شاہراہ کو بند کرنے کی کوشش کی اور ایک پولیس موٹر سائیکل کو نذر آتش کر دیا۔ غازی پور انڈسٹریل پولیس کے سپرنٹنڈنٹ محمد امجد حسین کے مطابق اب علاقے میں حالات پُرسکون ہیں لیکن پولیس ہائی الرٹ پر موجود ہے۔

یہ ہنگامہ آرائی حکومت کی منظور کردہ چھ رکنی کمیٹی کے اس فیصلے کے ایک دن بعد شروع ہوئی جس میں مزدوروں کی کم از کم اجرت میں 36 فیصد اضافے کی منظوری دی گئی تھی۔ پچھلے چار عشروں میں یہ سب سے کم اضافہ قرار دیا گیا ہے، جبکہ مزدور پچھلے کئی ہفتوں سے اپنی اجرت کو دوگنا کرنے کا مطالبہ کر رہے تھے۔ یہ فیصلہ بدھ کی علی الصبح مزدوروں اور مالکان کے نمائندوں کے درمیان تقریباً بارہ گھنٹے طویل مذاکرات کے بعد طے پایا تھا، مگر اعلان کے چند گھنٹوں کے اندر ہی احتجاج پھوٹ پڑا۔

مزدور رہنماؤں کا کہنا ہے کہ 36 فیصد اضافہ مطالبات سے بہت کم ہے جس سے مزدوروں کو باعزت زندگی کے لیے کافی آمدن نہیں ملے گی۔ واضح رہے کہ بنگلہ دیش میں گارمنٹس کی صنعت سے 40 لاکھ سے زائد افراد وابستہ ہیں اور ملک چین کے بعد دنیا کا دوسرا بڑا گارمنٹس برآمد کنندہ ہے۔ مسلسل احتجاج، فیکٹریوں کی بندش اور شاہراہوں کی بندش سے صنعتی پیداوار شدید متاثر ہو چکی ہے، جبکہ سابق وزیراعظم شیخ حسینہ کی جلاوطنی کے بعد سیاسی کشیدگی کے باعث ملک میں عدم استحکام کے خدشات بھی بڑھ گئے ہیں۔

stories.title: عظمیٰ بخاری کا مریم نواز کے بیرون ملک دورے سے متعلق خبر پر ردعمل
stories.summary:
وزیر اطلاعات پنجاب عظمیٰ بخاری نے وزیراعلیٰ مریم نواز کے مبینہ غیر ملکی دورے اور سرکاری طیارے سے متعلق زیر گردش خبروں کو سختی سے مسترد کر دیا ہے۔ سوشل میڈیا پلیٹ فارم ایکس پر اپنے بیان میں انہوں نے افسوس ظاہر کیا کہ بغیر کسی تحقیق کے بے بنیاد باتیں پھیلائی جاتی ہیں۔

عظمیٰ بخاری نے واضح کیا کہ وزیراعلیٰ کسی نجی دورے پر ہانگ کانگ نہیں جا رہی ہیں اور نہ ہی ان کے ساتھ کوئی فیملی موجود ہے۔ انہوں نے انکشاف کیا کہ یہ تاریخ میں پہلی بار ہے کہ کسی وزیراعلیٰ کو نوبیل پرائز کے لیے سرکاری سطح پر مدعو کیا گیا ہے، اور اس طرح کے جھوٹے شور شرابے سے کوئی فرق نہیں پڑتا۔

انہوں نے مزید بتایا کہ ملک کے مروجہ قواعد و ضوابط کے تحت سرکاری طیارے کے آپریشن اور دیکھ بھال کی ذمہ داری پاک فضائیہ کے پاس ہے اور اس کے لیے کسی اضافی اجازت کی ضرورت نہیں ہوتی۔ وزیر اطلاعات نے جھوٹی خبریں پھیلانے پر تنقید کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ اس نوعیت کی غیر مصدقہ خبروں کی وجہ سے قانونی نوٹس جاری کرنا پڑتے ہیں، البتہ انہوں نے یہ بھی ذکر کیا کہ خبر پھیلانے والے طارق صاحب نے مبینہ طور پر اپنی پوسٹ ڈیلیٹ کر دی ہے۔

stories.title: Industry Leaders Urge Technology Upgrades for Pakistan's Stone and Mineral Sector
stories.summary:
Sanaullah Khan, former Chairman of the All Pakistan Marble Industries Association (APMIA), underscored Pakistan's immense potential to develop into a prominent global hub for dimension stone trade, production, and processing during a high-level meeting in Karachi. The discussions brought together Italian diplomatic and trade officials, including Italian Consul General Fabrizio Bielli, Italian Trade Agency Director Dr. Salvatore Parano, and technical experts Engr. Paolo Marone and Engr. Claudia Chiappino.

The meeting convened prominent Pakistani quarry owners, mining representatives, and entrepreneurs dealing in marble, granite, onyx, and other natural minerals. Khan highlighted the critical need to modernize the domestic mining industry, improve processing efficiency, minimize material wastage, and boost the international standing of Pakistani stone products. The collaborative framework is coordinated alongside Confindustria Marmomacchine and the Italian Trade Agency.

Participants focused on introducing advanced Italian quarrying machinery, modern processing technology, and strict international quality standards to transform Pakistan's mineral sector from a raw-material exporter into a high-value, technology-driven industry. The visiting Italian delegation welcomed the proposals and expressed strong interest in fostering bilateral commercial ties, knowledge exchange, and technical cooperation.

This industrial engagement matters because upgrading Pakistan's mineral sector can unlock substantial export revenue and drive sustainable economic growth. By combining Italian engineering expertise with abundant local natural resources, the partnership aims to elevate the country's manufacturing capacity on the world stage.

stories.title: Sri Lanka A Cruises Into Asia Cup Rising Stars Final
stories.summary:
Lasith Croospulle and Sineth Jayawardena both hit centuries to drive Sri Lanka A to a commanding seven-wicket victory over India A in the first semi-final of the Asia Cup Rising Stars tournament. Facing a target of 318, Sri Lanka A successfully chased down the total to finish at 319-3 with more than eight overs to spare. The opening pair laid the foundation for the win by sharing a massive 174-run partnership, propelling their side to 85 without loss inside the first 10 overs.

Jayawardena led the early scoring with 105 runs from 70 balls, hitting 10 fours and six sixes before his dismissal in the 22nd era. Croospulle followed up with 116 runs off 107 deliveries, including 12 boundaries and three sixes, before falling in the 36th over. Nishan Madushka, with an unbeaten 58 off 56 balls, and captain Pavan Rathnayake, who contributed an unbeaten 31 from 16 balls, sealed the victory with an unbroken 53-run partnership for the third wicket.

Earlier in the match, India A posted a total of 317-8 after being sent in to bat. Abhishek Sharma led the Indian innings with 78 runs off 63 balls, followed by captain Tilak Varma with 53 runs and Shahbaz Ahmed, who added an unbeaten 54 from 48 balls. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi contributed 40 runs and Tanush Kotian chipped in with 28. In the bowling department, Ravindu Fernando, Janith Liyanage, and Nipun Dhananjaya each claimed two wickets for Sri Lanka A, while Lahiru Samarakoon picked up one.

stories.title: PACCC Chief Urges Pakistani Businesses to Enhance Global Market Competitiveness
stories.summary:
Naveed Anwar Chaudhry, President of the Pak American Chicagoland Chamber of Commerce (PACCC), has called upon Pakistani enterprises to elevate product and service quality to satisfy international criteria. Speaking at a reception hosted in his honor at the National Press Club on Thursday, Chaudhry emphasized that strengthening global market competitiveness is essential for expanding exports, drawing foreign investment, and improving Pakistan's overall economic standing, with a particular focus on gaining access to the United States market.

Chaudhry pointed out that the Pakistan Business Forum Europe (PBFE) actively promotes trade collaboration among the Pakistani diaspora in the US and Europe, offering crucial guidance to local businesses entering foreign markets. He also noted that trade volumes between Pakistan and the Chicagoland Midwest region have grown since the Chamber's inception, demonstrating a clear appetite for heightened economic cooperation. Furthermore, he underscored the significance of youth entrepreneurship, mentioning that the Chamber provides dedicated mentorship and business training to help young Pakistanis meaningfully contribute to national development.

Highlighting avenues for collaboration, Chaudhry shared that American business sectors have expressed keen interest in investing in Pakistan. He encouraged local entrepreneurs and exporters to aggressively engage in trade roadshows and international exhibitions across the United States to display their goods, build networks with international buyers, and enhance the reputation of "Made in Pakistan" as a trusted global brand.

The initiative aims to bolster the country's export-led growth by fostering robust business-to-business partnerships and helping local industries secure necessary international certifications. Chaudhry reiterated his dedication to establishing a solid international identity for Pakistani products, asserting that coordinated efforts and strategic trade relationships are vital for long-term economic progress.

stories.title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Government Formally Launches Guardianship Standard Operating Procedures
stories.summary:
The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government officially launched Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for guardianship during the provincial World Children’s Day 2026 event held at the Sahibzada Abdul Qayyum Auditorium in Peshawar on Thursday. Dr. Aamer Abdullah, Advisor to the Governor for Education and Social Welfare, served as the chief guest for the occasion, which was organized by the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Child Protection and Welfare Commission. Key officials, UNICEF representatives, civil society members, and children attended the gathering.

During the ceremony, the Commission signed Terms of Reference for mutual cooperation with renowned social worker and religious scholar Waliullah Maroof, officially designating him as the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Child Protection Brand Ambassador. Maroof will voluntarily assist in tracing missing children and reuniting them with their families. Dr. Abdullah praised Maroof's extensive humanitarian record, noting his successful efforts over the past five to six years in resolving complex family separation cases, some spanning nearly three decades.

According to data presented at the event, the Commission has reached 35,764 children, offered legal aid to 7,890 children and families, and successfully resolved 3,456 missing children cases. Additionally, the network is expanding with the addition of five new units to the existing 12 Child Protection Units across districts. The newly introduced SOPs, developed alongside UNICEF, aim to streamline the guardianship framework and are supported by an online digital database and portal to improve transparency and tracking.

Dr. Abdullah emphasized that ensuring child welfare requires unified participation from families, communities, and institutions. He also welcomed Helvetas Pakistan's plan to deliver technical and vocational skills training to 800 children, underscoring the government's commitment to broadening institutional partnerships and strengthening district-level child protection systems to prevent exploitation and neglect.

stories.title: Pakistan Customs Seizes Boat Carrying 40,000 Liters of Smuggled Diesel
stories.summary:
Pakistan Customs’ Marine Enforcement Unit in Gwadar successfully intercepted and seized a vessel carrying 40,000 liters of smuggled high-speed diesel off the Balochistan coast. Authorities valued the confiscated fuel and the boat, named Al-Behar-e-Amber, at approximately Rs40 million.

Officials reported that the operation was launched following specific intelligence regarding illegal fuel smuggling operations conducted via maritime routes. The enforcement team tracked and pursued the suspect vessel through harsh sea conditions for over 72 hours before successfully boarding and securing it.

Following the interception, legal actions were initiated against the individuals involved in accordance with applicable laws. While the department did not specify the precise origin of the fuel or the exact number of arrests made, they confirmed that the action forms part of a broader, ongoing anti-smuggling campaign led by Marine Enforcement Units in Gwadar and Gadani to eradicate the illegal petroleum trade along the coast.

stories.title: Islamabad Court Reserves Verdict on Appeal Challenging Judicial Magistrate's Order
stories.summary:
The District and Sessions Court in Islamabad on Thursday reserved its judgment on an appeal that challenges a judicial magistrate's ruling in a high-profile case. The case involves the mysterious death of 13-year-old domestic worker Fatima Asghar, who allegedly suffered physical torture while residing at the home of Afshan—the wife of an FIA Director—and Qari Ali Raza.

Additional District and Session Judge Raja Asif heard extensive arguments from both defense and prosecution counsels before reserving the final verdict. Akmal Khan, the defense counsel, argued that Judicial Magistrate Naima Iffat had overstepped her legal boundaries and assumed the role of an investigating officer, pointing out alleged contradictions in the magistrate's order and claiming that defense evidence was omitted from the official record.

Conversely, Special Prosecutor Wajid Munir strongly urged the court to dismiss the defense appeal. He maintained that the area magistrate acted well within her supervisory authority and that the ongoing police investigation into the tragic death of the young girl is proceeding correctly under Section 302 of the Pakistan Penal Code and related statutes.

The underlying written order by the judicial magistrate had directed investigators to scrutinize various aspects of the case, including determining the exact age of the deceased, verifying the relationship between the victim's family and the accused, and investigating potential child labor violations or financial arrangements under the Islamabad Capital Territory Domestic Workers Act and the Pakistan Penal Code.

stories.title: CDA Pledges to Share Service Delivery Timelines with Islamabad Business Community
stories.summary:
The Capital Development Authority has committed to sharing clear service delivery timelines with the Islamabad business community to enhance transparency and efficiency. During a visit to the Islamabad Chamber of Commerce and Industry, CDA Director of One Window Operations Chaudhry Abdul Rauf announced that the civic body is transitioning toward a fully cashless system by November 30. Additionally, a new digital portal is being created to support online applications, case tracking, and prompt objection notifications.

Rauf noted that roughly 24 to 25 public services are currently managed through the One Window facility under established timeframes. For instance, residential No Demand Certificates have a prescribed four-day turnaround, while straightforward property transfers without legal or administrative hurdles are processed within a single day. The authority has also implemented a cashless payment approach utilizing electronic challans to streamline and secure financial transactions.

ICCI President Mohammad Zikria Akbar Zia stressed the critical need for robust institutional cooperation between the Chamber and the CDA to resolve administrative bottlenecks and tackle public grievances. Other chamber leaders pointed out that commercial stakeholders still encounter delays regarding property transfers and NOCs, emphasizing the importance of advanced notice for expected completion periods and immediate SMS alerts for any application deficiencies.

The discussions underscored the shared goal of improving civic administration to support Islamabad’s growing population and expanding commercial activities. Both organizations agreed that closer liaison and further digitalization of services will foster a more responsive, accountable, and citizen-friendly environment for residents and business owners alike.

stories.title: Rafael Jodar Secures Spain's Place in Davis Cup Semi-Finals
stories.summary:
Rafael Jodar orchestrated a remarkable comeback victory in Bologna on Thursday, defeating Austria's Jurij Rodionov to send Spain through to a Davis Cup semi-final showdown against Britain. After losing a difficult opening set, the 20-year-old Jodar adjusted his strategy to become more aggressive and solid from the baseline, completely dominating the remainder of the match to finish with a 2-6, 6-0, 6-1 scoreline. 

Because teammate Daniel Merida had earlier defeated Joel Schwaerzler 6-4, 6-4, Spain secured an unassailable 2-0 lead in the tie, allowing star player Carlos Alcaraz to rest. Spain captain David Ferrer noted that Alcaraz, a seven-time Grand Slam champion who recently captured three consecutive individual titles including the ATP Finals, could potentially return for the singles matches on Saturday as Spain pursues its first Davis Cup title since 2019. 

Meanwhile, Britain booked their spot in the semi-finals earlier in the day by overcoming Alexander Zverev's Germany 2-1. Britain's world number one won his singles match against Arthur Fery 6-3, 6-2, which leveled the tie after Cameron Norrie lost his opening singles match to Jan-Lennard Struff in three sets. The decisive contest fell to the doubles rubber, featuring top-ranked doubles player Henry Patten and third-ranked Neal Skupski against Germany's Kevin Krawietz and Tim Puetz. 

The British duo easily claimed the first set 6-2 but were pushed to a tense tie-break in the second. Despite a missed service opportunity by Skupski at 6-5, the pair regrouped to secure a second match point, which was clinched via a sharp cross-court backhand to seal the 6-2, 7-6 victory. Britain will now advance to their first semi-final in seven years, while reigning champions Italy prepare to face the Czech Republic in the opposite semi-final bracket.

stories.title: Severe Thanksgiving Storm Knocks Out Power and Disrupts US Flights
stories.summary:
A powerful storm severely disrupted Thanksgiving holiday travel and daily life across the United States East Coast on Thursday, generating destructive wind gusts of up to 70 mph and heavy rains. The severe weather system knocked out electrical service to nearly one million utility customers at its peak, while causing widespread flight cancellations and significant delays at major transportation hubs, particularly in the Washington and New York City areas. 

According to FlightAware, the storm contributed to 454 US-related flight cancellations and 2,411 delays on Thursday. PowerOutage.us reported that over 908,000 customers remained without electricity late Thursday night, following earlier peaks near 961,000. Among the hardest-hit areas were Pennsylvania with over 207,000 outages, New Jersey with more than 179,000, Maryland with 139,000, Virginia with 106,000, Missouri with 100,000, and New York with over 68,000. 

The National Weather Service recorded wind gusts ranging between 50 and 70 mph across Virginia, Maryland, Delaware, New Jersey, New York, and coastal New England. In New York City, winds intensified to 56 mph at LaGuardia Airport, prompting NYC Emergency Management to monitor conditions. The combination of strong onshore winds and king tides triggered coastal flooding in low-lying areas. The severe weather threat also forced officials to postpone the historic 100th annual Macy's Thanksgiving Day parade in New York City, marking the first time the event has ever been rescheduled due to severe weather conditions. 

In a separate development on Thursday, President Donald Trump announced the approval of approximately $100 million in federal aid for Florida to assist with recovery efforts following separate severe storms and flooding in that region.

stories.title: Scientist Urges Greater Investment in Research and Technology at Bilateral Event
stories.summary:
Renowned scientist Professor Dr. Atta-ur-Rahman advocated for heightened financial backing in research, innovation, and technology during a recent seminar in Karachi. Held at the Chinese Consulate, the China–Pakistan Youth Dialogue was jointly organized by the Economic Diplomacy Forum and the Chinese Consulate to celebrate the 75th anniversary of diplomatic relations between Pakistan and China.

Dr. Atta-ur-Rahman, who previously served as Federal Minister for Science and Technology and founding chairman of the Higher Education Commission, urged Pakistan to emulate China's development framework. He emphasized the necessity of expanding research grants, offering tax incentives for private research and development, and creating contemporary technology zones alongside advanced research laboratories. Key figures, including Acting Consul General Dr. Feng Deheng and EDF founder President Dr. Muhammad Farooq Afzal, also addressed the attendees regarding educational cooperation and the evolving scope of the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor.

The event featured participation from university vice chancellors, academic experts, and students from multiple institutions in Pakistan, alongside virtual contributions from students at China's Sichuan Normal University. Discussions focused on deepening bilateral ties through joint academic programs, scientific research, and youth engagement. Leaders from both nations highlighted that future collaboration must heavily involve universities, entrepreneurs, and young professionals to build a sustainable knowledge-based economy.

stories.title: Bournemouth and AC Milan Secure Comeback Victories in Europa League
stories.summary:
English club Bournemouth and Italian giants AC Milan both recorded impressive comeback victories during the fifth round of the Europa League on Thursday. Ten-man Bournemouth maintained their perfect record in the competition by defeating Celta Vigo 2-1 in Spain, while Milan overcame a two-goal deficit to defeat Olympiakos 4-2. The round of matches was affected by security incidents, including violent clashes between Georgian police and Besiktas fans that temporarily halted the Turkish club's match against Hapoel Beer-Sheva in Batumi.

Bournemouth's manager Marco Rose guided his team to their tenth successive win in all competitions despite falling behind in the 19th minute to a goal from 39-year-old Iago Aspas. The visitors suffered a further setback when Bafode Diakite received a red card following a VAR review just three minutes later. However, the Cherries fought back after the interval when Alvaro Rodriguez headed in an equalizer from Amine Adli's cross in the 47th minute. Rayan then completed the remarkable turnaround with twelve minutes remaining by scoring from a Marcus Tavernier pass, lifting the Premier League side two points clear at the top of the standings.

In Greece, Ruben Amorim's AC Milan side boosted their qualification hopes by overcoming a difficult start against Olympiakos. Trailing following a Mike Maignan own goal and a strike from Joao Silva early in the second half, Milan mounted a strong response initiated by Omari Hutchinson's solo goal in the 61st minute. Hutchinson subsequently assisted an equalizer for Alphadjo Cisse and set up Christian Pulisic for a volley nineteen minutes from time, before Diego Moreira sealed the 4-2 victory in stoppage time.

The results carry significant implications for the group standings as teams battle for crucial knockout phase positions. Bournemouth's resilience keeps them at the summit of the 36-team table ahead of Juventus, while Milan's triumph lifts them into the playoff round places. Elsewhere, Crystal Palace defeated Real Sociedad 2-1 and Sunderland drew 1-1 with Jagiellonia, while European action also saw wins for Brighton, Monaco, and Trabzonspor.

stories.title: Conflicting Claims Emerge Over JUI-F Chief Fazl's Reported Arrest in Lahore
stories.summary:
Conflicting statements surfaced in Lahore regarding the reported detention of Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam-Fazl (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman near Thokar Niaz Baig. A local JUI-F official maintained that party leader Fazl had been taken into custody by Lahore Capital City Police Officer (CCPO) Bilal Siddique Kamyana and DIG Operations Faisal Kamran. Conversely, the DIG Operations firmly denied the arrest, stating that Fazl had safely returned to his residence with his convoy and that traffic on Multan Road and the motorway remained completely unhindered.

The contradictory claims arrived amid growing friction over JUI-F demonstrations and restrictions placed on the party's scheduled political activities across Punjab. Prior to the incident, the party approached the Lahore High Court after alleging that authorities had confined Fazl to his home and cordoned off his residence. The petition requested his immediate recovery and an urgent hearing so he could attend an all-parties conference arranged by the Lahore High Court Bar Association. Police maintained they neither arrested nor formally placed him under house arrest.

Political friction between Fazl and the federal administration has escalated since mid-October, driven by his opposition to the Centre's implementation of governor's rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The veteran politician also faulted the central government for failing to respect agreements despite his mediation efforts between the PML-N and the PTI-led KP government. Security details comprising police and Federal Constabulary personnel assigned to Fazl and his family in Islamabad and Dera Ismail Khan were withdrawn the previous week.

In a related development, Fazl's son and former federal communications minister, Asad Mahmood, received two consecutive summonses from the National Accountability Bureau (NAB) for November 10 and 14. The anti-graft watchdog called him over suspected irregularities in appointments at the Pakistan Post during his 2022-23 tenure. According to NAB sources, Asad failed to appear before the bureau despite being summoned twice.

stories.title: New Zealand Reach 246-5 on Opening Day Against India in Christchurch
stories.summary:
New Zealand reached 246-5 at stumps on the opening day of the second Test against India at Hagley Oval in Christchurch on Friday. Captain Shubman Gill won the toss and chose to bowl first on a green, seaming pitch featuring long and dense grass coverage, marking India's tenth toss win in twelve matches on their tour. Despite helpful bowling conditions, India's seam attack struggled with line and length, leaving New Zealand to battle through a challenging day of Test cricket.

Tom Latham anchored the home side's early innings with a score of 59, earning his 32nd Test fifty after surviving an earlier reprieve. However, a middle-session collapse saw New Zealand slip to 110-4 as India's Akash Deep removed Latham, Henry Nicholls for 16, and Rachin Ravindra for a golden duck. Debutant Gurnoor Brar also claimed a wicket on the stroke of lunch by trapping Devon Conway lbw for 31.

Facing a precarious situation, Tom Blundell and Daryl Mitchell staged a recovery by putting together a 74-run partnership. Mitchell was eventually dismissed for 31 after steering an offspinner from Washington Sundar to the leg slip fielder. Blundell, playing in his 50th Test, remained resilient and finished the day unbeaten on 53 from 117 balls, surviving a dropped catch on 49 by Yashasvi Jaiswal.

Glenn Phillips joined Blundell late in the day to add an unbroken 62-run partnership, reaching 36 not out from 64 balls at the close of play. Akash Deep was the pick of the Indian bowlers with figures of 2-52 from 21 overs, while Jasprit Bumrah went wicketless. The match is vital for both sides as New Zealand enters the contest in third place in the World Test Championship standings, with India sitting just behind them in fourth.

stories.title: Kenyan Court Rules US-Backed Ebola Facility Construction Breached Constitution
stories.summary:
Kenya's High Court ruled on Thursday that the government violated parts of the national constitution by permitting the construction of a United States-backed Ebola quarantine facility at a military base. Presiding Judge Patricia Nyaundi ordered an immediate halt to all further work at the project until the state satisfies specific conditions, notably disclosing the full details of its agreement with the United States government. The ruling represents a significant legal development in a controversy that previously triggered deadly protests in the central Kenyan town of Nanyuki.

The contentious project involved a 50-bed tented quarantine center situated inside the Laikipia Air Base. It was established to isolate individuals potentially exposed to the Ebola virus, including American citizens, during the ongoing outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The construction plan provoked intense public backlash from local residents who feared the introduction of the deadly disease into their community. The demonstrations turned violent, resulting in two fatalities before the High Court temporarily halted construction activities in late May.

During the legal proceedings, petitioners from the Katiba Institute argued that the government bypassed critical legal frameworks and failed to consult the public. Judge Nyaundi upheld these concerns, stating that residents and the people of Kenya had been unjustly denied any meaningful opportunity to examine or participate in decisions affecting their community. The court's decision also follows previous legal friction in which Health Minister Aden Duale was found in contempt of court for failing to comply with initial orders to suspend the site's development.

The ruling matters deeply to local activists and residents who view the judgment as vindication for their opposition and a defense of transparency over foreign health deals. Meanwhile, the United States State Department stated it is monitoring the legal developments and maintaining communication with Kenyan authorities. Kenya itself has recorded no new Ebola cases since October 19, having previously treated two imported cases from Congo, and is currently nearing the conclusion of its countdown period to be declared officially Ebola-free.

stories.title: Cricket Australia Expands Independent Ball-Tampering Review to Include Previous Ashes
stories.summary:
Cricket Australia announced on Friday that it is broadening the scope of its independent "Sandpapergate" forum to examine ball-management practices from the 2017-2018 season, including the home Ashes series against England. The governing body has explicitly ruled out reopening formal investigations into the infamous 2018 tour of South Africa. Instead, the newly expanded initiative invites players, coaches, and staff from that period to share confidential accounts of events in a protected environment.

The six-week voluntary forum will be led by senior counsel Fiona McLeod and is designed to gather principal themes and recommendations rather than assign individual blame or issue new sanctions. Interim chairman David Boon emphasized that the primary focus of the process is the welfare of those involved, acknowledging the heavy toll that renewed public attention has placed on players eight years after the incident. Cricket Australia has pledged to make McLeod's final report public to ensure transparency with supporters.

Talks surrounding the 2018 scandal were recently revived after Usman Khawaja alleged in his autobiography that the team leadership was widely aware of plans to alter the ball during the third Test in Cape Town, as well as the preceding match in Port Elizabeth. While Khawaja's claims received backing from former teammates David Warner and Bancroft, they directly contradict repeated denials from current captain Pat Cummins and other members of the bowling attack.

The expansion of the forum to cover the Ashes series won 40 by Australia allows participants to address wider practices from that entire Australian summer. By publishing the final findings without punitive measures, Cricket Australia hopes to address lingering questions from fans and players alike while providing a constructive platform to review historical team practices.

stories.title: Crude Oil Prices Climb Amid Renewed Supply Disruption Concerns in Middle East
stories.summary:
Crude oil prices advanced on Thursday following reports of renewed attacks and security incidents in the Middle East that stoked fears of supply constraints. Brent crude futures increased by USD 1.53, or 1.62 percent, to reach USD 96.14 a barrel, while US West Texas Intermediate crude futures rose USD 1.20, or 1.43 percent, to USD 84.88. Market activity remained on edge ahead of the US Thanksgiving holiday, with traders reacting closely to geopolitical developments.

The upward pressure on prices followed statements from Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthi movement claiming responsibility for strikes on Saudi Arabia’s primary oil refinery in Ras Tanura and Riyadh's financial district. Simultaneously, shipping through the Strait of Hormuz faced severe disruptions after Iran’s Revolutionary Guards reported that two tankers exploded and caught fire following strikes by sea mines near Oman’s Khasab port. These incidents threaten to stall the ongoing recovery of oil flows from the region.

Additional supply concerns emerged internationally, including production unit shutdowns at Thailand’s Phra Khanong oil refinery following a fire and serious damage inflicted by a drone attack on a Russian facility in the Krasnodar region. Meanwhile, official data showed that US crude inventories grew by 1.1 million barrels to reach 418.9 million barrels for the week ending November 20. OPEC+ ministers are scheduled to convene to review their upcoming output policy amidst ongoing discussions regarding production capacities and quotas.

stories.title: Euro Zone Bond Yields Rise as Global Equities and Oil Prices Recover
stories.summary:
Euro zone government bond yields increased on Thursday, breaking a four-session streak of declines as investors reduced their exposure to safe-haven assets. The shift was driven by a broader recovery in global equity markets and higher crude oil prices. Markets displayed minimal reaction to reports regarding the prospective nomination of Spain's Pablo Hernandez de Cos to lead the European Central Bank, with analysts anticipating that the institution will maintain its core focus on inflation and consensus-driven decision-making.

Germany's 10-year government bond yields climbed by 5 basis points to reach 3.266 percent, moving up from a multi-day low recorded the previous day. Equities gained ground as concerns regarding recent US tariff proposals eased, while the Thanksgiving holiday provided a temporary respite from volatility in the technology sector. Furthermore, European Central Bank data indicated that corporate lending growth reached its fastest pace in over three years, reflecting economic resilience against high energy costs.

German 2-year bond yields, which closely track policy rate expectations, rose by 6 basis points to 3.079 percent. Regarding the leadership transition at the central bank, EU officials indicated support for Spain's De Cos over Klaas Knot to succeed Christine Lagarde. Analysts noted that while De Cos previously held a dovish stance while heading the Bank of Spain, future policy direction will likely be shaped by broader economic conditions.

stories.title: امریکہ میں پاکستانی سفیر کا پاک ایران تنازع پر بیان
stories.summary:
امریکہ میں تعینات پاکستان کے سفیر رضوان سعید شیخ نے کہا ہے کہ پاکستان نے امریکہ اور ایران کے درمیان تنازع کے دوران ایک قابلِ اعتماد ثالث کا اہم سیاسی کردار ادا کیا ہے۔ انہوں نے یہ بات امریکہ میں یومِ شکر گزاری کے موقع پر اپنے ایک پیغام میں کہی، جس میں دوطرفہ تعلقات اور عالمی امور پر گفتگو کی گئی۔

سفیر پاکستان نے اپنے بیان میں مزید کہا کہ پاکستان آنے والے وقتوں میں بھی دنیا بھر میں امن و خوشحالی کے فروغ اور مختلف تنازعات کے پرامن حل کے لیے اپنی تعمیری خدمات پیش کرتا رہے گا۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ گزشتہ ایک سال کے دوران دونوں ممالک کے درمیان شراکت داری اور تعلقات میں مزید استحکام آیا ہے، جو کہ انتہائی لائقِ تحسین ہے۔

اس موقع پر دوطرفہ تعلقات کی اہمیت پر زور دیا گیا اور علاقائی امن کے قیام کے لیے سفارتی کوششوں کو جاری رکھنے کے عزم کا اعادہ کیا گیا۔ سفیر پاکستان کے اس بیان سے عالمی سطح پر ملک کے مثبت کردار اور امن دشمن عناصر کے خلاف کی جانے والی کوششوں کو اجاگر کیا گیا ہے۔

یہ بیان ایسے وقت میں سامنے آیا ہے جب خطے اور دنیا بھر میں امن و امان کی صورتحال کو بہتر بنانے کے لیے مختلف سطح پر سفارتی رابطے جاری ہیں۔ پاکستان نے ہمیشہ خطے کے تنازعات کو بات چیت اور ثالثی کے ذریعے حل کرنے پر زور دیا ہے تاکہ بین الاقوامی سطح پر استحکام قائم رہ سکے۔

stories.title: UN Projects Zero Growth for Global Maritime Trade in 2026
stories.summary:
Global maritime trade, which accounts for moving over 80 percent of the world's goods, is projected to experience zero growth in the year 2026. According to the United Nations trade and development agency UNCTAD, this stagnation follows a modest expansion of 1.9 percent in 2025 and is driven by persistent shipping disruptions and trade uncertainties stemming from conflict in the Middle East.

The disruptions heavily impact key corridors such as the Strait of Hormuz—a vital route for roughly a fifth of global oil and items like fertilizer—as well as the Red Sea, Black Sea, and Panama Canal. UNCTAD reported that gross tonnage traffic through the Strait of Hormuz plummeted by approximately 95 percent by early March, dropping from around 120 daily crossings before the crisis. Consequently, many vessels are rerouting around the Cape of Good Hope, leading to longer voyages, inflated operating costs, and heightened freight volatility.

While alternative transport networks have kept trade moving at higher costs, the ongoing bottlenecks disproportionately pressure developing economies. Interim UNCTAD chief Pedro Manuel Moreno warned that a prolonged fuel shock could push consumer prices in least-developed countries to almost twice the global average increase.

To combat these vulnerabilities, UNCTAD urges governments and industry stakeholders to move beyond a reactive crisis response. The agency emphasizes that long-term resilience requires better preparation, predictable rules, robust international cooperation, and investments in global fleets, ports, and seafarer protection.

stories.title: Pakistan Cricket Board Announces Central Contracts for Eight Women Cricketers
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Cricket Board has finalized central contracts for eight women cricketers for the 2026-27 season, running until June 30, 2027. The categories were determined based on recent form, fitness, and performances across formats. Regular fitness assessments will be conducted, requiring contracted players to maintain strict standards throughout the contract duration.

Fatima Sana, a 24-year-old all-rounder, and left-arm spinner Sadia Iqbal have been placed in Category A. Fatima was rewarded for consistent performances with bat and ball, having recently become the first Pakistani woman to play in England's The Hundred and Australia's Women’s Big Bash. Sadia has maintained her status among the country's top performers and previously topped the ICC Women’s T20I Bowling Rankings.

Muneeba Ali Siddiqui, Nashra Sundhu, and Sidra Amin were assigned to Category B in recognition of their steady contributions across multiple formats. Meanwhile, Category C features opening batters Gull Feroza and Sadaf Shamas alongside veteran player Ayesha Zafar. Their inclusion highlights strong recent domestic and international performances as well as the future needs of the national team.

stories.title: Minister Tarar Critiques Fazl and Bilawal Over Protests and Constitutional Debates
stories.summary:
Information Minister Attaullah Tarar censured Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam-Fazl (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman for organising protests that disrupted traffic across multiple cities. Speaking on the Geo News programme 'Aaj Shazeb Khanzada Kay Saath', Tarar minimised the disruptions and advised the JUI-F leader to step back from confrontation and seek alternative paths instead of blocking thoroughfares. He asserted that Fazl was pursuing a confrontational path despite receiving contrary advice from members within his own party.

Tarar drew sharp comparisons, stating the JUI-F's conduct resembled that of a militant organisation and demanding that Fazl clarify whether his loyalties lay with Pakistan or with Afghanistan and the Taliban. Although JUI-F protests caused urban traffic blockades, most affected routes subsequently reopened. The information minister also targeted Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari for opposing a public referendum on the creation of new provinces, arguing that the public should be permitted to voice opinions on the matter rather than having the PPP chairman show reluctance.

Furthermore, Tarar questioned Bilawal's characterisation of PTI founder Imran Khan as a political prisoner, contending that Bilawal incorrectly applied political arguments in legal matters. Despite disagreements on specific political questions, the minister clarified that ties between the ruling coalition parties remained intact and suggested the PTI could be consulted if new provinces reached parliament. Bilawal had previously rejected a referendum during a Multan address on November 26, calling it potentially the most controversial in national history and insisting parliament address the issue democratically.

The proposal for creating new provinces has sparked internal disagreements within the ruling coalition, with the PPP urging that matters be settled through constitutional avenues in parliament. Reports from The News on November 22 indicated that no formal governmental proposal for a provincial referendum had been initiated within relevant ministries, the Prime Minister's Office, or the Election Commission of Pakistan.

stories.title: Peshawar High Court Orders Compensation for Decade-Long Detention Without Trial
stories.summary:
The Peshawar High Court has ordered the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government to pay Rs10 million in compensation to Ameen Hussain, a man who spent a decade imprisoned in Karachi Central Prison without trial. Chief Justice SM Attique Shah ruled that the prolonged detention, lasting from May 2016 until his transfer to Kurram in May 2026, violated the petitioner's fundamental constitutional rights. 

Under the 21-page verdict, half of the financial penalty must be provided by the provincial government through the chief secretary within 60 days. The remaining half will be divided equally among specific former public officials identified in an inquiry report, including a past assistant political agent, assistant commissioners, and district police officers from Kurram.

The background of the case shows that Hussain completed his sentence in a narcotics case in May 2016 but was not released due to a pending murder charge in Kurram under the Frontier Crimes Regulation. Despite multiple written requests from Karachi prison authorities and the Sindh home department, officials in KP failed to transfer him for a decade, denying him access to court or bail.

The high court has directed the chief secretary and provincial police chief to initiate disciplinary proceedings under efficiency and discipline rules against responsible officials, trace the missing original case file, and submit a compliance report within two months. Chief Justice Shah noted that no amount of money can restore lost liberty, but the significant penalty reflects the severity of the injustice.

This ruling matters as a strict judicial rebuke of administrative negligence and systemic delays in Pakistan's justice system. By holding individual officers personally liable for financial compensation alongside disciplinary action, the court aims to deter future human rights violations and enforce accountability among public functionaries.

stories.title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Directs Urgent Reforms in Gemstone Sector
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has called for immediate actions to modernize Pakistan's gemstone industry during a high-level review meeting in Islamabad. He emphasized that outdated mining practices and an absence of sufficient processing facilities currently result in severe economic losses. To counter this, the government aims to transform the sector from raw material extraction to finished product exports.

Key figures presented during the session revealed that Pakistan holds roughly 300 million carats of gemstone reserves, with over 9,000 miners extracting more than 30 varieties of precious stones. The industry involves more than 5,500 businesses nationwide. However, more than half of the material is lost during mining operations, and the sector continues to suffer from a lack of technical expertise and limited value-addition capabilities.

To address these gaps, Prime Minister Sharif ordered the creation of international-standard laboratories for gemstone certification and identification. He also mandated that master trainers be sent to Thailand and Sri Lanka for specialized processing instruction, with support from the foreign secretary and local diplomatic missions. Additionally, a Rs4.10 billion initiative is underway to build facilitation centres across Islamabad, Azad Jammu and Kashmir, and Gilgit-Baltistan.

These comprehensive measures matter because they seek to elevate the credibility and competitiveness of Pakistani gemstones on the global stage. By improving technical skills and local certification processes, the administration intends to capture greater long-term value from the country's extensive natural mineral resources and boost national export volumes.

stories.title: FBR Sets New Quota Rules for Duty-Free Solvent and White Spirit Imports
stories.summary:
The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) has established a formal quota allocation framework for eligible manufacturers importing and locally procuring white spirit and solvent oil without federal excise duty. Issued via SRO 2286 of 2026, the directive amends the Federal Excise Rules 2005 by adding a dedicated chapter to oversee quota distribution, input tax adjustments, and consumption monitoring.

Under the updated regulations, registered manufacturers with a valid Form-L licence must submit annual quantity requests to the Inland Revenue Commissioner. Applicants are required to disclose their production capacity, historical consumption figures from the past two financial years, supplier names, and input-to-output ratios. The commissioner evaluates these details using sales tax returns, electronic invoices, import declarations, and physical inspections when necessary, with a decision window of one month.

Established manufacturers receive quotas based on the previous year's finished product supplies or a two-year average with a 10 percent allowance, whereas newer units operating under a year are capped at 50 percent of their installed capacity. The rules stipulate that allocated materials must be consumed within six months, and companies must submit quarterly reports alongside annual reconciliations. The commissioner holds the authority to suspend quotas for up to one month if diversion, fraud, or missing reports are suspected.

This regulatory update matters because it introduces stringent oversight to prevent the misuse or fraudulent declaration of duty-free industrial inputs. Furthermore, taxable goods producers must integrate with the FBR's electronic invoicing system to qualify for duty-free supplies, with any violations triggering duty recovery, surcharges, and legal penalties.

stories.title: Pakistan Stock Exchange Closes Lower Amid Regional Tensions and Cautious Trading
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Stock Exchange experienced a sluggish trading session on Thursday, giving up early morning gains to close slightly lower as investors adopted a cautious stance. Market participants weighed persistent regional geopolitical tensions, a lack of positive economic catalysts, and profit-taking during rollover week. Topline Securities reported that market activity remained subdued and range-bound throughout the day.

The benchmark KSE-100 index finished the session down 60.56 points, or 0.03 percent, settling at 178,060.69. During trading, the index fluctuated between a low of 177,781 and a high of 178,374. Positive momentum from selective buying in second- and third-tier stocks was offset by selling pressure in major equities. Key positive contributors such as Engro Holdings, Engro Fertiliser, PSO, Interloop Ltd, and Bank Al-Habib added roughly 290 points, while major draggers including Pakistan Services, Fauji Fertiliser, and United Bank subtracted about 175 points. Ali Najib, Deputy Head of Trading at Arif Habib Ltd, noted that thin global liquidity due to the US Thanksgiving holiday also influenced sentiment.

Trading volume slipped to 617 million shares, while the total traded value remained flat at Rs18.2 billion, with Pervez Ahmed Co leading the volume chart by trading over 80.2 million shares. In broader developments, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Türkiye prepared to convene in Islamabad on November 27-28 for discussions regarding their mutual defense agreement. Additionally, the stock exchange announced plans to introduce monthly options contracts on selected individual stocks by June 2027 in partnership with Chinese stakeholders who hold a 40 percent stake in the PSX.

stories.title: United Nations Launches Global Campaign Against Rising Gender-Based Violence Worldwide
stories.summary:
The United Nations launched its annual 16 Days of Activism campaign against gender-based violence on Wednesday, urging global societies and governments to reject abuse, support survivors, and demand accountability. Running until Human Rights Day on December 10, the initiative emphasizes that systemic disbelief, victim-blaming, and unanswered calls for help foster an environment of impunity for perpetrators. The campaign highlights escalating concerns over physical and digital abuse, particularly in environments where inadequate protections discourage victims from seeking assistance.

To contextualize the crisis, a UN report released on November 25 regarding Pakistan revealed that online harassment frequently spills into physical dangers, contributing to femicide, suicides, physical assaults, and job losses. Survey data from Pakistan indicated that 54 percent of women believe victims should leave their jobs when harassed, while 83 percent noted that male perpetrators often evade consequences. Regionally and globally, the figures remain stark. In Arab states, 60 percent of female internet users reported experiencing online violence. Furthermore, the UN Office on Drugs and Crime and UN Women estimated that 50,000 women and girls were killed globally by intimate partners or family members in 2024, averaging 137 deaths every day, or one every ten minutes.

The campaign launch also brought renewed attention to Afghanistan, where UN Women warned that the safety of women and girls is deteriorating rapidly. Susan Ferguson, UN Women’s Special Representative in Afghanistan, emphasized that while risks are mounting, essential support networks are collapsing due to severe funding and aid cuts. The UN continues to press governments, technology corporations, and local authorities to reinforce legal protections, adequately fund support organizations, and hold offenders strictly accountable.

stories.title: Nine Injured in Massive Oil Facility Explosion in Bangkok
stories.summary:
A powerful blast struck an oil facility in the Phra Khanong area of eastern Bangkok on Thursday, leaving nine people injured, with three in critical condition. According to reporters at the scene, the explosion generated a massive column of flames followed by thick black smoke, and the force of the blast rattled doors several kilometres away.

Thailand’s Energy Minister, Akanat Promphan, visited the site and noted that the fire originated at a distillation tower located at least 100 metres away from the main oil depot, which helped limit the overall destruction. The facility is operated by the Thai energy conglomerate Bangchak Corporation, which announced that the situation was brought under control within 30 minutes of the incident.

Authorities conducted air quality checks within a one-kilometre radius of the refinery, testing for contaminants such as carbon monoxide and sulphur dioxide, and reported normal levels with no irregularities detected. However, the government suspended plant operations until the energy ministry is fully confident that work can resume safely. Meanwhile, police evacuated students from nearby schools and asked local residents to leave the area.

The Erawan Emergency Medical Centre, managed by Bangkok city authorities, confirmed the casualty figures, updating its initial assessment to reflect the nine injuries and three critical cases. Investigations into the exact cause of the explosion are currently underway by the company and relevant authorities.

stories.title: Tanker Capsizes off Ibiza Waters, Sparking Environmental Response
stories.summary:
Spanish authorities launched an emergency response on Thursday to prevent marine pollution after a chemical products tanker capsized north of Ibiza. The Maltese-flagged vessel, named Med Emre, was transporting up to 7,000 tonnes of diesel, or approximately 66,000 barrels of refined products, while traveling from Algeciras to Barcelona.

Balearic Islands emergency services reported that all 17 crew members were rescued from the incident. One crew member was later confirmed dead at a hospital in Ibiza, while six others sustained minor injuries, primarily suffering from hypothermia. The cause of the maritime accident remains unclear at this stage.

Government sources clarified that the vessel was lying keel up rather than completely sunk, and images broadcast by Spanish media showed the lower portion of the ship visible above the sea surface. Spain activated a specialized marine pollution response mechanism as a precaution, though officials noted this did not mean pollution had been detected along the coast.

To evaluate potential environmental hazards in the ecologically valuable Mediterranean waters, the Spanish maritime rescue service Salvamento Maritimo dispatched a boat and a plane to the area. Maritime tracking data from Kpler confirmed the cargo details of the capsized vessel as rescue and assessment operations continued.

stories.title: Former IHC Judge Warns Constitutional Amendments Sparked Inter-Court Conflict
stories.summary:
Retired Islamabad High Court Justice Mohsin Akhtar Kayani has cautioned that the 26th and 27th Constitutional Amendments have provoked a direct conflict between Pakistan's superior courts. Speaking at an Institute of Regional Studies seminar in Islamabad titled 'Personal Safety and Justice in a Digital World', he stated that bypassing traditional judicial precedents and establishing problematic new ones has weakened the country's legal structure.

Justice Kayani pointed specifically to legal disputes arising from the Nadia Sarwar case before the Federal Constitutional Court, arguing that parliament remains the correct forum to resolve inter-court disagreements. He stressed that while the interpretation of the Constitution is a judicial duty, crafting legislation is the exclusive domain of lawmakers. He urged parliamentarians to thoroughly debate legal measures before enactment to ensure a complete understanding of their practical implications.

In addition to judicial matters, the former judge criticized the enforcement and understanding of online expression regulations, particularly the Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act (Peca). He highlighted that journalists, lawyers, and members of parliament are frequently impacted by these rules, and noted that the individuals targeted by the legislation were never properly consulted. He specifically appealed to authorities to halt the immediate issuance of notices to media organizations under Section 26-A simply for publishing news reports.

These remarks carry significance as they highlight growing friction between the executive, legislative, and judicial branches following recent constitutional changes. Justice Kayani's warnings underscore ongoing concerns regarding freedom of the press, the protection of media personnel, and the institutional separation of powers in Pakistan's digital age.

stories.title: Quetta Court Grants Bail to Journalist Shahid Maitla
stories.summary:
A district and sessions court in Quetta has approved post-arrest bail for senior journalist Shahid Maitla, ordering his release upon the submission of surety bonds worth Rs3 million. District and Sessions Judge Ghulam Qadir Shah Bukhari delivered the ruling on the bail petition filed on behalf of the journalist.

The legal proceedings against Maitla originated from a formal complaint lodged by former caretaker prime minister Anwaarul Haq Kakar with the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency. Following the complaint, the NCCIA apprehended Maitla in Islamabad, subsequently transferring him to Quetta where he was remanded to jail under judicial orders.

Prior to the sessions court ruling, Maitla's defense team approached Judicial Magistrate Syed Akhtar Shah with a post-arrest bail application, which was initially rejected. Following that setback, Maitla's counsel, Rahib Buleedi, challenged the decision by filing a new petition in the sessions court, which ultimately overturned the earlier ruling and granted his release.

stories.title: Oil Prices Rise Slightly, Aiming to Break Three-Week Losing Streak
stories.summary:
Oil prices ticked up slightly and are on track to break a three-week losing streak, driven by ongoing attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz and Saudi energy infrastructure that raised supply anxieties from the Middle East. Brent crude futures increased by 4 cents to $96.61 a barrel, while US West Texas Intermediate crude futures reached $85.78 a barrel.

The recent upward pressure on prices follows disruptions caused by regional hostilities. A projectile struck Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery, temporarily halting some operations, killing a Nepalese worker, and wounding others. This followed Houthi claims of strikes against Ras Tanura and Red Sea ports. Analysts note that depleted inventories and persistent shipping risks leave the market highly vulnerable despite potential recovery in Gulf exports.

In response to supply disruptions from the Iran conflict, OPEC+ is anticipated to maintain its output targets for the first quarter of 2027 during an upcoming Sunday meeting. Additional supply concerns emerged as Ukraine intensified drone strikes on Russian oil refineries, while operational fires also disrupted facilities in Thailand and Venezuela.

stories.title: Saudi-Led Coalition Destroys 50 Houthi Military Targets Across Yemen
stories.summary:
The Saudi-led coalition supporting Yemen’s internationally recognized government announced that it executed a major military operation destroying 50 Houthi military targets across three provinces. Coalition spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki al-Maliki stated that the operation struck legitimate military objectives in Sanaa, Al Hudaydah, and Saada. The action followed a Houthi attack on an oil refinery in Jazan, Saudi Arabia, which resulted in the death of a Nepalese worker and injuries to several others.

Amid escalating fighting, the Yemeni army reported clashes approximately 80 kilometers from the capital, Sanaa, alongside active front lines in Marib, Al-Jawf, and Taiz. The World Health Organization reported that 13,343 people have been killed or injured since August due to intensified hostilities. Additionally, the International Committee of the Red Cross facilitated an exchange of human remains between the Yemeni government and the Houthis, marking the first such exchange since fighting intensified in July.

The renewed conflict follows the breakdown of a 2022 ceasefire in July, plunging the country back into active combat. The coalition warned that any future attacks targeting civilians and civilian infrastructure would face a decisive military response. Both sides continue military operations across multiple contested regions while international bodies attempt to manage humanitarian concerns.

stories.title: US Approves SpaceX Plan to Launch Space Data Center Satellites
stories.summary:
The administration of the United States has granted authorization to Elon Musk’s aerospace firm, SpaceX, to deploy up to one million satellites designed to operate data centers in orbit. According to Federal Communications Commission documents, this approval extends through 2040 for the Starmind constellation, which will process large volumes of data for use on Earth. FCC Chairman Brendan Carr endorsed the move, noting its alignment with artificial intelligence development, while several other entities like Google and Blue Origin are also pursuing similar space-based computing initiatives.

The initiative leverages low Earth orbit constellations and partnerships with chipmakers like Nvidia, which will provide space-ready Vera Rubin processors. Proponents highlight that orbiting data centers can continuously capture solar energy far more efficiently than terrestrial alternatives. SpaceX plans to commence initial satellite launches in late 2027, utilizing its own fleet of rockets to establish the necessary infrastructure.

However, the project has drawn significant criticism from scientific and environmental organizations. The American Astronomical Society expressed deep concern that the brighter, more numerous satellites would severely disrupt astronomical observations and degrade the night sky. Additionally, Earthjustice attorney Jan Hasselman emphasized the broader impacts of such large-scale orbital expansion on the planet.

Technical obstacles also remain a primary concern for observers. Experts point out that hardware must endure extreme temperatures, high space radiation levels, and potential impacts from micrometeorites and space debris. Despite these hurdles, the FCC's clearance marks a major step forward for commercial space infrastructure following SpaceX's recent stock market debut in June, which raised roughly $85.7 billion.

stories.title: مشرق وسطیٰ میں جاری کشیدگی کے باعث عالمی منڈی میں خام تیل کی قیمتیں بلند
stories.summary:
مشرق وسطیٰ میں جاری کشیدگی اور آبنائے ہرمز میں تیل بردار جہازوں پر حملوں کے نتیجے میں عالمی منڈی میں خام تیل کی قیمتیں رواں ماہ کی بلند ترین سطح کے قریب برقرار ہیں۔ رائٹرز کے مطابق سعودی عرب کے توانائی کے بنیادی ڈھانچے پر حملوں نے تیل کی برآمدات متاثر ہونے کے خدشات کو مزید بڑھا دیا ہے۔

عالمی معیار برینٹ خام تیل کے سودوں کی قیمت 38 سینٹ یا 0.39 فیصد کمی کے بعد 96.19 ڈالر فی بیرل ریکارڈ کی گئی، جبکہ اس سے ایک روز قبل برینٹ کی قیمت میں تقریباً 2 ڈالر کا اضافہ ہوا تھا۔ دریں اثنا، امریکی ویسٹ ٹیکساس انٹرمیڈیٹ خام تیل کی قیمت 1.73 ڈالر یعنی 2.07 فیصد اضافے کے ساتھ 85.41 ڈالر فی بیرل پر آگئی۔

اے این زیڈ بینک کے تجزیه‌کار برائن مارٹن اور ڈینیئل ہائنس کے مطابق اگر مشرق وسطیٰ میں کوئی بڑی کشیدگی نہ بھی بڑھے تب بھی دستیاب رسد میں کمی کے شواہد ملنے پر برینٹ خام تیل کی قیمت 100 ڈالر فی بیرل سے تجاوز کر سکتی ہے۔

رپورٹ کے مطابق دونوں عالمی بینچ مارکس مسلسل چار ہفتوں کی مسلسل گراوٹ کے بعد پہلی بار ہفتہ وار اضافے کی طرف گامزن ہیں۔ قیمتوں میں ماضی کی کمی کی ایک بڑی وجہ یہ توقع تھی کہ امریکی صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ وسط مدتی انتخابات کے بعد ایران کے خلاف فوجی کارروائیوں میں اضافہ نہیں کریں گے۔
